title: I really love the game I'm making
author: Failosipher

comments.author: Failosipher
comments.body:
Most recent devlog can be found here: 
https://failosipher.itch.io/engines-of-hate/devlog/1709658/good-isnt-good-enough

Discord: 
https://discord.gg/5TaeaeVTT

Honestly, every day, I'm just blown away not just at the amount of work I can get done, but the quality of it. Every day is just dreaming up whatever the fuck I want and seeing it realised. Does anyone else feel like they're making the game of their dreams?

Also, always happen to answer questions.

replies.author: AsparagusOk8818
replies.body:
i'm definitely in a perpetual state of shock 

LLMs are the kind of Star Trek thing that was supposed to be within the fantasy realm of the show. "Computer, make thing" was a matter of Deus Ex Machina. 

but... now it's here. There's little sense in having an LLM brew an Earl Grey for you, but it would be trivial to do if you wanted to.

comments.author: KevinJohn57
comments.body: looks interesting, What parts of the development process are u sing AI for?

replies.author: Failosipher
replies.body:
Im using meshy for 3d models. 
Gpt for image gen. 
Claude running from within cursor. 
Unity. 
Suno for music. 
Eleven labs for sfx.

replies.body:
Oh nice man, i see good things about Meshy lately, been a while since i looked at. Working mostly 2D. GPT is quite nice for images indeed. Also using Suno, probably still the best for music. 

I'll have a look at Elevenlabs too, didnt know they did SFX too, thought only voice. 

  
I'm lazy so im using Claude with CLI/MCP straight in unity instead of in the IDE 

  
Anyway, thanks for the answer man, keep up the good work, game looks great!
